nodes.rationale: OGAS cards for Chancellor Ostenveld, Theron Waide, Sera Voss, Jaret; includes NPC relationship map

nodes.label: Chancellor Ostenveld
nodes.rationale: OGAS: practices strategic ignorance of ritual cost. Gave 7-day ultimatum in Session 4. Utiliarian position: ten lives vs thousands

nodes.label: Theron Waide
nodes.rationale: Archivist who knew the ritual cost for 11 years (Day 4,017 journal). Added T.W. annotation to astronomical record. Carries sealed drawer key

nodes.label: Sera Voss
nodes.rationale: Dawnborn leader, Dawnhalls director. Willing to die (OGAS goal). Has resonance dreams. Anchor #1 implied by position. Radiates presence detectable by Divine Sense

nodes.label: Jaret
nodes.rationale: Restorer faction member. Knows Dawnborn must die for ritual completion. Leads with argument before cost. Honest if asked directly
